tamil_question: மகளிர் உரிமைத் தொகைக்கு வருமான வரம்பு எவ்வளவு?
tamil_answer: கலைஞர் மகளிர் உரிமைத் திட்டத்தின் கீழ் தகுதியான குடும்பத் தலைவிகளுக்கு மாதம் ரூ.1,000 (ஆண்டுக்கு ரூ.12,000) வழங்கப்படுகிறது.

scenes.vo: This is Lakshmi. A mother in Tamil Nadu. One evening, a forward arrives in the family group. Magalir Urimai is now two thousand rupees. Register today.

She wants to know if it's true. But the answer is buried in a forty page Government Order, written in language few people read. She shouldn't need to understand a forty page document to understand her rights.
What if she could simply ask? That's why we built Pakkam.
She taps the orb, and asks in her own words.
scenes.vo_b: Pakkam answers from the Government Order itself, with the order number and the page.
scenes.vo_c: And she can open the original page, and see the line for herself.

scenes.vo: But the moment that matters most is when Pakkam doesn't know. We tested forty questions outside the documents. Pakkam correctly refused thirty nine. The one failure showed us where to improve. Lakshmi doesn't need an assistant with an answer for everything. She needs one that knows when it doesn't have one.
scenes.short_vo: And when the documents don't say it, Pakkam won't guess. It says so.

scenes.vo: Tamil, Tanglish, Hindi or English. A rumour shield for WhatsApp forwards. Every scheme, straight from the source.
Pakkam. Speak. Hear. See the proof. Because everyone deserves to know.

note: Lakshmi is a fictional, illustrative character. Every answer and page shown is real, recorded live from the site.
